search_window.basis: Starts at the previous persisted supplementary Food Line recall heartbeat completed_at; recency-2-day overlap was used for discovery, but positive findings required newly established access consequences since the last check.

coverage_notes: Supplementary U.S. high-value miss-class recall only; production Food Line nationwide collection remains authoritative.

Completed 12 targeted web searches total (10 recency-two-day and 2 date-specific), with no query transport failures. Four categories covered: sole/last/full-service grocery-store losses, weather/disaster-related canceled emergency distributions, abrupt pantry/food-bank access closures, and official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions.

No verifiable new qualifying food-access disruption reported or becoming effective since the prior completed hourly check. Search results were predominantly earlier 2025/2026 incidents, resource/event guides, scheduled distributions, and general benefit articles without a new official interruption.

Excluded as outside this window: Spencer, NY sole-store fire (published September 14, 2026; https://www.wbng.com/2026/09/14/town-spencer-recovering-after-losing-only-grocery-store-fire/); HCCM canceled Bethany distribution dated October 2, 2026 (https://hccm.org/get-help/fresh-food-for-all.html); older central Ohio weather-related pantry closures (January 28, 2026; https://spectrumnews1.com/oh/columbus/news/2026/01/28/snowstorm-strains-food-pantries).

October 24 distributions listed in Baltimore, Florence, Tucson and elsewhere were scheduled and not reported canceled; excluded. No official newly dated SNAP/WIC/EBT disruption was verified in the window.
Index lag and limited regional search recall mean no-findings is not proof of zero real-world incidents.
No approval, publication, schedule edit, disabling, or change to the production collector.
